Elite Assassin Katars
(Normal Katars | Exceptional Katars)

Katars are (Assassin only) one-handed weapons. Some Assassin Skills require Katars (Claw-class). Higher Katars can have from 1 to 3 skills ranging from +1 to +3. Higher Katars have a better chance of having higher level skills and higher bonuses to those skills.

All Elite Katars can have bonuses to skills. Magic and Rare Katars may additionally get +1 or +2 to Assassin Skills or from +1 to +3 to an Assassin skilltab. Only Magic Katars can have +3 to a skilltab.
